**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/06 (Mon) 13:55
- [USER] User requested a summary of an article from the MakerDAO website.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MIP 39 outlines a proposal to change the collateral requirements for MakerDAO's multi-collateral Dai (MCD) system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The proposal suggests a "collateral on-ramp" that would allow new assets to be added as collateral types with lower risk parameters than existing assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The collateral on-ramp would be implemented in two phases: the first phase would involve a "bootstrapping period" during which new collateral types would be added with low risk parameters, and the second phase would involve gradually increasing the risk parameters over time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This proposal is intended to increase the diversity of assets that can be used as collateral in the MCD system and reduce the risk of a single asset dominating the system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The proposal is currently in the "review" stage of the Maker Improvement Proposal (MIP) process.
